title: Residence Certificate Application
description: Standard application form for obtaining Gram Panchayat Rahivasi Dakhla (Residence Certificate) for educational, scholarship, or banking purposes.

title: Water Connection Application
description: Application for new household domestic tap connection (Nal Jodani) or pipe transfer under the Gram Panchayat Water Supply Scheme.

title: Property Tax Assessment Form
description: Application for Namuna No. 8 property entry, mutation (Ferfar), or new house construction assessment in village abadi records.

title: NOC Application (No Objection Certificate)
description: General No Objection Certificate request for MSEDCL electricity meter connection, small village business, or solar rooftop installation.
requiredDocs: House Tax & Water Tax Clearance Receipt

title: Birth Registration Request
description: Statutory Form No. 1 for reporting and obtaining official Birth Certificate extract from the Gram Panchayat Registrar of Births & Deaths.

title: Death Registration Request
description: Statutory Form No. 2 for reporting a death within Gram Panchayat jurisdiction and obtaining official Death Certificate extract.

title: Tax Exemption / Rebate Application
description: Application for statutory House Tax exemption for ex-servicemen families, persons with disabilities, or women self-help group premises.

title: Family Income Verification Recommendation
description: Verification worksheet signed by Gram Sevak/Talathi for submitting family income certificate request at Tehsil Maha-e-Seva Kendra.

title: PMAY-G / Gharkul Housing Scheme Application
description: Citizen application and self-declaration form for inclusion in rural housing and sanitation welfare schemes.
